title: Long-Term Storage and Vendor-Managed Inventory (VMI) Services for Government-Owned Microelectronics
description: DLA Weapons Support market research for vendor-managed inventory storage, management, packaging and distribution of Government-owned serialized microcircuits: EDI ANSI X.12 transactions, Government property module and IUID registry, long-term storage to GEIA-STD-0003A, monthly reconciliation, annual wall-to-wall inventories, and disposal per CNSSI 3006. Logistics and warehousing only. Contemplated firm fixed price with one base year and up to eight option years. The notice asks for business size under NAICS 493190 (the NAICS field itself is blank on SAM.gov). No set-aside used.
